name: 99 Nights in the Forest Online 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: 99 Nights in the Forest Online is an action survival game where you and players from around the world have to spend 99 nights in a forest full of haunted and often dangerous challenges. Your main goal is to survive, but in order to do that, you will need to follow prompts by keeping your campfire going, defending your safe territory, gathering resources, and foraging for food to stay alive.
